notes_for_editor: Record id us-al-havana is Hale County (OSM 358997035, 32.8597, -87.6169; elevation 135 m matches the record and TopoZone's 443 ft). Not in the NHLR Alabama list or the FFLOS cache, so no register entry to cite. No build year, staffing, fire, or access source was found; the story gives no status claim beyond the site-now sentence. The 1819 News column is statewide and is cited only for the general climbing warning, not for anything about Havana. The anyplaceamerica page returned HTTP 403 and was not used. Search results also surfaced an Alabama Forestry Commission post on fire towers, which was not read. Next step if a human wants more: an AFC or Hale County record for Havana, or a site visit.
